purpose: Distinct targets exposed by comparison with the twelve displayed political dimensions; these are authored propositions or research variables, not validated latent factors.

constructs.name: Constitutionally divided territorial authority
constructs.proposition: National and regional institutions should each have constitutionally protected final authority in assigned areas.
constructs.neighbor: Revocable delegation to local institutions; confederation; generic decentralization

constructs.name: Public accommodation of cultural difference
constructs.proposition: Public institutions should make reasonable accommodations for harmless minority cultural practices rather than merely tolerate private difference.
constructs.neighbor: Private tolerance; uniform public rules; migration admission

constructs.name: Presumption of peaceful migration
constructs.proposition: Peaceful people have a presumptive moral claim to settle across national borders absent specific countervailing reasons.
constructs.neighbor: Concern for foreigners; cultural accommodation; unrestricted entry under every circumstance

constructs.name: Moral permissibility of defensive armed force
constructs.proposition: Proportionate organized armed force can be morally permissible to defend people from attack.
constructs.neighbor: Support for military intervention abroad; nationalism; absolute pacifism

constructs.name: Humanitarian military intervention
constructs.proposition: Under stringent conditions, outsiders may use military force to stop mass atrocities without a direct national-security interest.
constructs.neighbor: Defensive war; military action for economic interest; concern for foreigners

constructs.name: Cross-border trade restrictions
constructs.proposition: Whether voluntary cross-border exchange may be restricted for domestic economic aims alone.
constructs.neighbor: Market coordination within a country; concern for foreign persons; international political authority

constructs.name: Technology deployment under uncertainty
constructs.proposition: How to balance expected benefits against uncertain harms when deciding whether to deploy a new technology.
constructs.neighbor: Technological determinism; human enhancement; belief that all innovation is progress

constructs.name: Nontherapeutic human enhancement
constructs.proposition: Whether safe, voluntary enhancement of ordinary adult capacities beyond treatment is permissible in principle.
constructs.neighbor: Support for medical treatment; general optimism about technology

constructs.name: Revisability of inherited social norms
constructs.proposition: An inherited social norm may warrant revision on grounds of equal participation despite its continuity and familiarity.
constructs.neighbor: Personal importance of tradition; support for every novel policy; historical progress thesis
